routes.name: Mythical Traverse
routes.desc: From a low start below the route Lightning traverse the base of the wall up left to a drop off from good pockets just left of the route Jaws.

routes.name: Jurassic Traverse
routes.desc: Start from either a sit (6a+) or from a stand start (6a) at the edge of the small cave (Jurassic Cave) next to the leftmost route Kings Landing and traverse the base of the wall to the right to a no hands rest on a large foot blob. Traverse further right after the rest to add on another less difficult but fun section for full credit.

routes.name: Rock n Roll Traverse
routes.desc: Originally done from right to left starting from the far right side of Rock n Roll Wall. Traverse the base of the wall to the left to a no hands rest in an alcove. Good in either direction. Technical vertical face climbing.
